$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the ceiling. Every ratio the harness computes is 1 here, so
any change that breaks row matching, path matching or admitted-line matching moves this case first,
and it is the only case that proves all nine admitted-line sets accept their own firing line.
The report is CONSTRUCTED. No live run of the eval has ever happened, so there is no real capture
that scores against this ground truth. See storedOutput.origin on every case.
derivation: Ground truth plants nine defects: H4@22, H1@16, L1@19, H3@31 and C1@38 in seeded/checkout.spec.ts,
then C3@17, C4@23, C5@31 and H10@39 in seeded/orders.service.spec.ts. Four of the nine rows start
The verdict carries nine findings, one per planted row, each naming the fixture the row was planted
in at exactly the line the rule fires on. Every planted row therefore finds an unmatched finding
with the same basename, the same row and a line inside its admitted set: hits 9, criticalHits 4,
Nothing is reported against clean/profile.spec.ts, so falsePositives is 0, and every one of the nine
findings matched a plant, so unattributed is 0. All nine name a file, so unlocated is 0 and reported
The counts the harness derives from these: recall 9/9 = 1.00 against a 0.70 floor, CRITICAL recall
4/4 = 1.00 against a 1.00 floor, nonFalsePositiveRate (9 - 0)/9 = 1.00 against a 0.80 floor.
score and recommendation are read straight off the verdict. The CLI ledger puts them at
100 - 4x10 - 4x5 - 0x2 - 1x1 = 39, and any Critical at all forces Block.
No finding names a file outside the review set, so outOfScope is 0 and falsePositives is unchanged by it.
